Subject: Datasprint — request to schedule 60–90m technical workshop & draft agenda

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Datasprint is evaluating a conversational search + summarization flow for internal support documents, with expected peak concurrency of ~60 requests/min and strict PII handling requirements. You mentioned the need to validate latency at 1–2s p50 for short prompts, and an SOC 2 / KMS conversation for procurement.

Next step proposal: schedule a 60–90 minute technical workshop with our ML/Infra team where we can:
- Walk your engineering team through the runtime architecture and inference choices
- Run a short eval on a representative prompt set (we'll bring a sandbox model)
- Discuss security/KMS, data retention options, and VPC/private deployment considerations
- Review estimated unit economics and autoscaling patterns for your expected load

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue 27 Apr, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 28 Apr, 14:00–15:30
- Thu 29 Apr, 09:00–10:30

I attached a draft agenda (Datasprint_TDX_agenda_v0.3.pdf). Can you confirm which slot works and who from your engineering and security teams will attend? Also flag any must-cover items so we can adjust the agenda.

I'll loop in Marissa (solutions) and Vivek (ML infra) to coordinate the workshop and prep materials.

Best,
Priyom Das
